pictures.name: PL1-Medina-Mosque
pictures.prompt: The simple early mosque of Medina, long ago: a courtyard of packed earth, mud-brick walls, a roof of palm fronds resting on rough palm-trunk pillars, morning sunlight falling in long shafts through the fronds onto woven mats. Calm, humble, sacred. No people or human figures of any kind. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.prompt: The doorway of the same palm-roofed mosque: a pure, brilliant white light fills the open doorway, and the sand at the threshold is smooth and untouched, with no footprints, as if someone had arrived from nowhere. Mysterious and gentle. No people or human figures of any kind. Only light, no figure in the doorway. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle.
